hall_timber_frame._scope: Device-local presentation only; no durable state, portal or progression change. OFF until matched Medium/High three-judge verdict.
hall_timber_frame._why: F17#6 distinct interior-structure approach: retained judges describe an indoor street. Installed timber posts, cross ties and upper brackets give the nave a repeated structural rhythm without replacing the accepted shell. Does not claim to remove the clerestory facade defect.
hall_timber_frame._provenance: quaternius_medieval Roof_FrontSupports accessor bounds [-2.743130,-0.118262,-0.027265]..[2.743128,0.112928,0.627262], Prop_Support [-0.099302,1.211389,-0.118123]..[0.099302,2.920026,1.918150]. Only architecture is transformed; creatures unchanged.

_why_r6_pedestals: REVERTED at landing (13 Oct, coordinator): the spread put the Meadows pedestal 1.6 m from the wall and the ordinary capsule walk to it failed (smoke_net_f48_coop_loop, smoke_net_homestead_station_craft); positions are back to z +-1.5/+-4.5. Original note: F17#6 r5 judge: the companion stood inside the Shrine Room lecterns; the inner pair left a 2.5 m centre lane from the doorway. Each column spreads to z +-2.7 / +-5.4 (inside the +-7 m walls): a 4.9 m lane. Order and biome slots unchanged.
_why_r2_arches: F17#6 r2 judge: sealed arches still read as flat dark planes by day and black voids at night; a locked door read as a loose slab before a bright blue surface; floating labels read as debug text. Sealed: lighter stone brick with its normal map and a stone keystone; locked: a dark recess behind a door widened into the frame; both keep a warm light floor; arch names and states on a wooden plaque on the arch surround. TUNABLE.
_why_r5_plaque: F17#6 r5 judge: dark boards with pale sans lettering still read as UI tooltips. A lighter weathered plank with dark painted lettering reads as a painted wooden sign. Text, size and place unchanged.

night_fill_lights._why: F17#6 r3 judge: the far third of the nave read as a black void at night (about 1.5/255); a dim warm fill at the end bay, night only.

shrine_doorway_frame._why: F17#6 r2 judge: the Shrine Room opened off the nave through a raw unframed 6 m cut (east wall x=7, z -3..3, three ground wall modules left out for the walk). Posts and a lintel frame it, outside the walked clearance.

stand_presentation._why: F17#6 r1 judge: the Shrine Room lecterns were too small for the room. Each stands on a low stone plinth (the installed Stairs_Exterior_Platform, 2 x 1 x 2 m native, scaled to plinth_size_m) at this scale; the collider scales and rises with it. Presentation only. TUNABLE.
stand_presentation._why_r2: F17#6 r2: the scaled exterior platform left ragged alpha edges; the plinth is a plain block in the kit's rock texture, the biome name carved on its front.

arch_materials._why_sealed: F17#6 r1 judge: sealed arches read as flat navy placeholder planes. Sealed now multiplies this cool stone grey over the kit's brick texture inside the recessed fan (dark centre, lighter rim: still dark but visible, F17#2); locked arches show the kit's ornamented door. TUNABLE.

light._why_day_night: F17#6 r2 judge: the interiors did not change at night. Lanterns burn low by day and at full strength with a shorter reach at night, so they pool. TUNABLE.
light._why_flame_at: F17#6 r4 GPU judge: the flames floated as small white bulbs beside unlit cages. The installed Lantern_Wall bracket reaches about 0.85 m out from the wall and its cage hangs at y 0.3-0.55 (mesh vertex probe), so the flame and the light sit in the cage.

pedestal_collider._provenance: Installed BookStand.gltf POSITION accessor bounds: X[-0.25348,0.25363],Y[-0.00250,1.44429],Z[-0.25552,0.25567]; native metres, no model scale change.

_why_home_membrane_night: Coordinator ruling on the F17#6 r4 judge: at night the home arch's open membrane (z=-12.8, straight through the entrance) read as a flat cream card filling the doorway. While WorldLook is dark its emission is scaled down and its colour dimmed so the doorway reads as a lit vestibule, not a lamp. Presentation only; arch state and portal logic are unchanged (F17#5 checks emission_enabled, which stays on). TUNABLE.
_why_interior_volumes: F17#6 r4 judge: the objective beam showed indoors (through the creature and the nave roof). Hall-local interior boxes (nave x -7..7, z -15..15 under the 9.4 m ridge; Shrine Room x 7..17, z -7..7), measured from the shell's wall and roof modules; objective_beacon.gd hides the beam while the camera is inside one. Presentation only. TUNABLE.
_why_interior_ceiling: F17#6 r8 (a whole-nave ceiling at 6.2 m) scored no gain and is reverted to the r7 aisle panels. F17#6 r5 judge: sky and the wings' outer roofs showed through the nave from inside. crossing_hall.gd closes each interior_volumes box with a flat ceiling of the installed Floor_WoodDark kit tiles at its measured wall-top height. Presentation only, no collider.
_why_hall_furnishing: F17#6 r9 (judges r7/r8: the nave read as a street of house fronts, no hall furniture; +1.5-2.0): a feast table across the far end and benches in the wall bays between the arches, installed quaternius_fantasy kit at native scale, colliding and keep-clear for the companion. Walking lane x -3..3 and the arch approaches stay clear.

interior_ambient._why: F17#6 judges: the night sky ambient flooded the nave and Shrine Room flat blue. While WorldLook is dark, Hall materials carry a uniform ambient-only occlusion of this strength, so the lanterns shape the room (ReflectionProbe ambient has no effect under Compatibility). TUNABLE.
interior_ambient._why_creature_night: F17#6 claude-r1 judge: at 23:00 the companion turned saturated blue-violet indoors; the Hall's materials carry this night ambient occlusion, a creature's did not. With creature_night_ambient_enabled, a deployed creature inside a declared interior at night wears per-instance copies of its materials with an ambient-only occlusion of creature_night_ambient (scripts/world/interior_creature_ambient.gd). Presentation only. Default OFF. TUNABLE.
interior_ambient._why_night_floor: F17#6 r3 judge: night left a black void at the far end, sealed infill brighter than by day and the Shrine Room daylit. The batched shell sits past Compatibility's per-object light cap, so lanterns alone cannot shape it: at night Hall materials halve their albedo and carry a faint warm emission floor in their own texture. TUNABLE.
interior_ambient._why_r2: F17#6 r2: with the nave glazed the room still read evenly lit at night; a lower ambient lets the wall lanterns make pools.

companion_pedestal_clearance._why: F17#6 claude-r1 judge: the companion's body passed through the Shrine Room lectern pedestals (shrine-pedestals and shrine-pedestals-reverse, day and night). With enabled, each pedestal declares a keep-clear circle (its widest footprint's half-diagonal plus margin_m) that the follower's indoor station refuses and a standing companion walks out of (follower_creature.gd KEEP_CLEAR_GROUP). Placement only, no collider change. ON from F17#6 r7 (with the spread lecterns and the follower camera fade). TUNABLE.

_why_interior_lights: F17#6 r1 judge: the nave had no warm interior light at night. Six wall lanterns between the aisle arches (with the two original lamps, eight interior lights, inside the reviewed Hall interior set) give the nave warm pools between the aisle arches (the east middle lamp hangs over the Shrine Room doorway). Lanterns show an emissive flame so the light has a visible source.

interior_lights._why: F17#6 r4: the Shrine Room had no warm light at night
F17#6 r1 judge: the nave end wall needed a focal point; this lantern sits between the two end banners (meadows_catalog_presentation.json hall_nave_end_banner_*)

frontage._why: F17 destination r1 DAY NO/NIGHT NO: complete the installed central gable/clerestory at the existing road-facing end, identify the public threshold and put warm practical fixtures on that real facade. Native module scale; no new floor/collider, entrance, route or camera changes.
frontage._why_tower: F17#1/#6 code-blind judges: the Hall read as the road's end only because of the layout and was barely taller than the inn. A stone crossing tower (installed MegaKit UnevenBrick walls, 4x4 round-tile roof, brick gables) rises over the nave entrance to about 17.5 m so the Hall is the tallest village roofline and a stone mass against the timber houses. Visual only: no floor, collider, entrance or route change.
frontage._why_upper_windows: F38/F17 night witness: upper window wall modules contain apertures but no glass, so retint alone left black voids. Add the installed family's native matching window inserts at the existing wall transforms; reuse the declared warm glass material. Presentation only, no new collider, height, route or portal state.
frontage._why_door_pools: F17#6 r3 judge: at night the front door read as a flat emissive rectangle (the home arch membrane seen straight through the entrance at z=-15) and no light fell on the ground at the door. A low warm pool on the threshold step outside and one in the vestibule (between the entrance and the home arch at z=-12.8) light the step and the arch reveal so the doorway reads as a lit way in. Lights only: no mesh, collider, route or arch change. TUNABLE.
